description: Confirm a work or organization account through sign-in

expectedOrgDomain.description: Optional DNS hostname for the organization (e.g. company.com) to match against the IdP directory.

internalSocialToken.description: Opaque token from the hosted org sign-in or work-email code session; not your app API key.

provider.description: How the work email is confirmed: Google Workspace or Microsoft sign-in, or email (a one-time code sent to the work address).

walletAddress.description: Wallet to associate with the verified org identity.

title: ownership-org-oauth
